  FIX: when _gl_resolved=true, append CONFLICT_GITLEAKSIGNORE_UNION_VERIFIED=true to GITHUB_ENV, and drop the `.gitleaksignore` line with grep -Fxv in the resolver's post-run violated-file handling (6-8 lines). HARDENING_RISK_SCORE: 1
